title: Supply Basis for Charging a Corrected Claim — Prescription Insurance on File
content:
Under **Prescription Insurance on File**, the supply basis of a corrected claim — how many copays its supply is charged — is set by the corrected fill's days supply as dispensed, read from the refill in the Prescriptions fill ledger.

## Rule

| Corrected fill's days supply | Charged |
|---|---|
| 84 days or more | 2.5 copays, whatever its exact length |
| 28 to 34 days | One copay, whatever its exact length |
| Any other length | The copay prorated per day over 30 days: its days supply divided by 30 copays |

## Both sides of each band

| Days supply | Band | Copays charged |
|---|---|---|
| 27 | Other length | 27 divided by 30, which is 0.9 |
| 28 | 28 to 34 | 1 |
| 34 | 28 to 34 | 1 |
| 35 | Other length | 35 divided by 30, which is 1.1666… |
| 83 | Other length | 83 divided by 30, which is 2.7666… |
| 84 | 84 or more | 2.5 |
| 90 | 84 or more | 2.5 |

## Worked figure (hypothetical copay of 15.00)

- A 30-day corrected fill is charged one copay: 15.00.
- A 90-day corrected fill is charged 2.5 copays: 15.00 multiplied by 2.5, which is 37.50.
- An 84-day corrected fill is charged the same 2.5 copays: 37.50.
- A 45-day corrected fill is charged the copay prorated per day over 30 days: 15.00 multiplied by 45 and divided by 30, which is 22.50.
